summary: Frontend-only verification of mobile QuickChips date-preset strip. Live preview tested at 390x844 and 1280x900. 7 of 8 spec checks PASS cleanly; 1 minor semantic concern on 'Next week' resolution when today is Sunday.

verified_checks.home_mobile_tonight_click_navigates_to: /stays?checkin=2026-06-28&checkout=2026-06-29 (correct, no area param since whereArea empty)
verified_checks.stays_mobile_when_picker_label_after_chi: When Jul 3 – Jul 5 (regression OK — When trigger shows picked range)
verified_checks.desktop_1280x900_home_chips_hidden: DOM element exists but is_visible() = false (md:hidden Tailwind class working correctly)
verified_checks.desktop_1280x900_stays_chips_hidden: DOM element exists but is_visible() = false (md:hidden working)

action_items: MINOR: 'Next week' chip math — when today is Sunday (dow=0), the current modulo formula `(((1-dow)+7)%7)||7` evaluates to 1, producing nextMon = today+1 (Jun 29). The review-request expected Mon Jul 6 → Jul 13 (Monday of the NEXT calendar week). User-facing impact: on a Sunday the 'Next week' chip points to tomorrow rather than 8 days out, which collides with 'Tonight'. If desired behavior is always >= 7 days out, change formula to `daysToMon = (((1 - dow) + 7) % 7); if (daysToMon < 2) daysToMon += 7;` or `|| 7` on the outer expression (currently `|| 7` only triggers when the modulo is exactly 0, i.e. when today is Monday). All other days of the week produce the correct 'next Monday'.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickChips.jsx chips are recomputed only on mount via useMemo([]) — if user leaves the tab open across midnight, labels will stale until navigation. Acceptable trade-off, but worth a comment in the file.
QuickChips.jsx uses new Date() at module-level inside buildChips(); fine, but if multilingual (Hebrew) is added, the `fmt = format(d, 'MMM d')` won't localize — pass locale from i18n if needed.
Stays.jsx: chip strip wrapper has `mt-2` which works, but on devices smaller than 390px (none observed in preview) horizontal scroll may clip — minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional pass; 1 minor date-math semantic concern noted

context_for_next_testing_agent: QuickChips works as specified. data-testids confirmed: hero-quick-chips, hero-quick-chips-{tonight|this-weekend|next-week|this-month}, stays-quick-chips, stays-quick-chips-{...}. Home: navigates to /stays?checkin&checkout (+area if set). Stays: just updates checkin/checkout, URL syncs via syncUrl effect, switches to flat grid. md:hidden hides chips on >=768px. pt-[220px] mobile / pt-[152px] md+ on stays-page wrapper. Today on preview = 2026-06-28 (Sun).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works. The only follow-up is whether 'Next week' on Sunday should mean tomorrow or 8 days out — code currently chooses tomorrow, spec expected 8 days out.
